title: Export wizard and residency mapping for audit-ready evidence bundles
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Build a self-serve Export Wizard in Console that lets customers assemble audit-ready evidence bundles scoped by: residency mapping (which datasets and artifacts are considered 'in-region'), retention profile selection, time range, and DPA/Dataset tags. The wizard should: 1) support multiple export formats (ZIP of files, JSONL manifest, and a signed CSV summary), 2) include automated evidence hashing and provenance metadata, 3) surface estimated export size and retention implications, and 4) provide a one-click package suitable for customer security/audit teams and internal support agents. Goal: reduce manual compliance requests and agent time-to-deliver from days to hours.
acceptance_criteria: Console exposes an Export Wizard flow that allows selection of residency mapping and retention profile
Export output formats: ZIP (files + manifest), JSONL manifest, and CSV summary are produced and downloadable
Export includes provenance metadata: dataset IDs, model version, request logs (redacted PII per policy), and retention policy references
Estimated size and time-to-export shown before starting export and an async notification when complete
Audit bundle contains verifiable hashes and a machine-readable manifest consumed by internal evidence-collector service
Support agents can generate an export on behalf of a customer (RBAC-tracked) and attach it to an incident ticket
comments: 2026-02-24 Marisol Vega: Initial scoping meeting with Trust. Agreed scope: residency mapping UI + retention profile selector + export formats. Raised need for provenance metadata and signed manifests.

2026-03-01 Liam Chen: Engineering spike completed. Proof-of-concept export stream created; estimated CPU/IO impact measured. Rough estimate: 5 points for full flow including agent-on-behalf feature. Blocking: S3 signed URL quota and long-running job orchestration patterns.
2026-03-04 Design (Asha Patel): Uploaded Figma flow for wizard steps and confirmation modal. Feedback requested on labeling of "In-region artifacts" vs "Region-bound datasets". Link in attachments.
2026-03-06 Security (Ravi Menon): Flagged retention metadata exposure. Action: include automated PII redaction step for exported request traces. Security review required before release.

2026-03-09 PM (Marisol): Decided to support three export formats to cover both SOC auditors (CSV summary) and security teams (JSONL manifest + zipped artifacts). Prioritized signed manifest for legal evidence chain.

2026-03-12 ENG (Liam Chen): Opened GH PR #8271 with async export worker and manifest schema v0.1. Dropped raw transcripts by default; include redaction proof. Requesting design final sign-off and security checklist.
2026-03-12 Support (Nina Alvarez): Drafted runbook for 'Generate export on behalf of customer' with RBAC steps and audit log requirements. Link to runbook in attachments.
notes: Trade-off: full-text transcript inclusion increases bundle size and PII risk; decided to default to redacted traces and allow opt-in full-text under customer-signed request.
Decision: retention profiles map to tenant-configured retention policies in backend (same canonical objects used by internal GC job) to avoid duplicate policy definitions.
Operational concern: large exports should be rate-limited and queued to avoid impact to runtime serving; engineering spike suggests offload via batch workers and pre-signed object staging.
Future: consider adding a 'legal-ready DPA package' template that bundles signed DPA, residency attestation, and last-12-months export for enterprise customers.
